sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Ashina Outskirts is the area outside and leading up to Ashina Castle.
Sculptor's Idols:
- Dilapidated Temple
- Outskirts Wall - Gate Path
- Outskirts Wall - Stairway
- Underbridge Valley
- Ashina Castle Gate Fortress
- Ashina Castle Gate
- Flames of Hatred

sections.heading: Dilapidated Temple
sections.text:
A Buddhist temple and a retreat from all the madness gripping Ashina's lands, filled with effigies created by the Sculptor. It acts as a hub for the exploration of Ashina and gradually grows a little more busy as time passes by.

sections.heading: Outskirts Wall
sections.text:

Later, Ashina Soldiers and the Central Forces clash on a newly built bridge during the final invasion.

sections.heading: Underbridge Valley
sections.text:
Under the bridge to Ashina Castle is a deep, wide valley where the Great Serpent makes its home.
On the other side of the valley is a dark cave where the first Headless is fought. A tunnel opening from the cave leads to Senpou Temple.
Allies | Enemies
None | Headless
Lizard
Great Serpent
Pellet
On a ledge that drops down towards the Sculptor's Idol.
Gachiin's Sugar
Towards the cave with the Headless.

sections.text:

sections.heading: Flames of Hatred
sections.text: A fiery battlefield littered with corpses of soldiers and horses and prowled by the Demon of Hatred.
